description: Update the top-level docs to reflect the new song-planner agent, SOP 09, the guided/collaborative mode, and the PLAN->WRITE guided seam. Independent content-wise but should run last so tables reflect the final state of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002.
steps: README.md: Update the '## Agents' heading and table from '5 Roles' to 6 — add a song-planner row (What It Does: produces an approvable Song Brief before lyrics via guided planning; loads core/methodology/song-planning.md; Invoke With: 'plan a song', 'song brief', 'outline a track', 'help me plan', 'plan out a song', 'brief for'). Place it first (planning precedes writing) or adjacent to songwriter. Update the SOP table to add row '09 | Planning a Song | link to /.kiro/sops/09-planning-a-song.md | guided brief creation before writing'. Add a sentence in the Quick Start / agents area mentioning the guided/collaborative mode (plan and write step-by-step with methodology-backed suggestions and per-section critic checks). Update any count references ('5 thin agents', '8 SOPs') in the Repository Structure block to 6 agents and 9 SOPs.

CHANGELOG.md: under '## [Unreleased]' '### Added', add bullets for: (1) the song-planner package — core/methodology/song-planning.md (canonical planning methodology elevating SOP 01 Phase 1 into a reviewable Song Brief), .kiro/agents/song-planner.md (thin agent), .kiro/sops/09-planning-a-song.md, the 12-section SONG BRIEF template + SONGNAME.brief.md convention + one sample brief; note it references songwriting.md/critique.md rather than duplicating craft logic; (2) the guided lyric-writing mode — GUIDED/COLLABORATIVE MODE added to the songwriter agent (section-by-section propose -> self-flag via critique.md's full 12-category rubric -> confirm), the Song Brief consumption seam, and the shared 'Collaborative / Guided Mode' framing across planner and writer.

WORKFLOW_DIAGRAM.md: reflect the new PLAN->WRITE guided seam. Add a SONG-PLANNER node/stage feeding a [Song Brief, user-approved] artifact into the songwriter, and note the guided/collaborative loop (suggest default -> flag concerns -> confirm) applies to both planning (brief decisions) and writing (sections). Update the agent overview diagram to include the planner and update the pipeline to PLAN -> [Brief] -> WRITE(guided) -> CRITIQUE -> OPTIMIZE. Keep the existing ASCII-diagram style.

SONGWRITING_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md: if it enumerates agents/SOPs/the pipeline anywhere, update those enumerations for consistency (add planner/SOP 09/PLAN stage). If it does not enumerate them, make no change. Verify with grep before editing.
acceptance_criteria: README.md Agents table lists 6 agents including song-planner with the correct invoke phrases; SOP table includes SOP 09 row; guided/collaborative mode is mentioned; structure-block counts updated to 6 agents / 9 SOPs.
CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased]/Added has bullets covering the song-planner package and the guided lyric-writing mode, noting no craft-logic duplication.
WORKFLOW_DIAGRAM.md shows the PLAN -> [Song Brief] -> WRITE(guided) seam and includes the song-planner in the agent/pipeline diagrams.
SONGWRITING_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md is consistent with the new agent/SOP/pipeline set (or unchanged if it does not enumerate them).
verification: grep README.md for 'song-planner' and 'SOP 09' / '09' row and confirm the Agents and SOP tables updated; confirm counts (6 agents, 9 SOPs).
grep CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] block for 'song-planner' and 'guided' bullets.
Read WORKFLOW_DIAGRAM.md and confirm the PLAN->WRITE seam and planner node are present.
grep SONGWRITING_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md for agent/SOP/pipeline enumerations and confirm consistency.
findings: Docs-only change; no build/test (Markdown project, validator out of scope). Updated README.md (Agents heading 5->6 Roles, added song-planner row first + updated songwriter row to note guided mode + brief seam; added SOP 09 row; added planner triggers + a Guided/Collaborative Mode paragraph to Quick Start; Repository Structure counts updated to 7 method files / 6 agents / 9 SOPs; added song-planner to the Community Use universal-agents list). CHANGELOG.md: added two bullets at top of [Unreleased]/Added for the song-planner package and the guided lyric-writing mode, noting craft logic is referenced not duplicated. WORKFLOW_DIAGRAM.md: added SONG-PLANNER node to the agent overview (feeds [Song Brief, user-approved] into the songwriter, both output to songs/), added a PLAN stage to the Full Pipeline (PLAN -> [Brief] -> WRITE(guided) -> CRITIQUE -> REVISE -> OPTIMIZE -> VERIFY), and added a new 'Guided / Collaborative Mode (PLAN -> WRITE seam)' ASCII section showing the shared loop (suggest default -> surface concerns -> user confirm -> next) for both planner (12 brief sections) and writer (self-flag via critique.md full 12-category rubric). SONGWRITING_KNOWLEDGE_BASE.md: NO CHANGE — grep + TOC review confirmed it is a pure craft reference (12 sections) and does not enumerate agents, SOPs, or the toolkit pipeline (Section 10 'Songwriter's Workflow' is human writing exercises, not the agent pipeline). Verified all referenced files exist: core/methodology/song-planning.md, .kiro/agents/song-planner.md, .kiro/sops/09-planning-a-song.md, examples/songs/standalones/Three_In_The_Morning.brief.md. Single-source-of-truth framing preserved; no craft rules added or redefined.
